queries.text:
CurrentFleetMapView()
| project
    drone_id,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    operational_condition,
    asset_state,
    mission_status,
    connection_state,
    altitude_m

let S = CurrentFleetOperationalSummary();
union
(S | project Metric = "Availability", Value = AvailabilityPct, SortOrder = 1),
(S | project Metric = "Connectivity", Value = ConnectivityPct, SortOrder = 2),
(S | project Metric = "Mission Completion", Value = MissionCompletionPct, SortOrder = 3),
(S | project Metric = "Platform Health", Value = HealthyPct, SortOrder = 4)
| order by SortOrder asc
| project-away SortOrder

let Q = CurrentStreamIntegrityReport();
union
(Q | project Metric = "Duplicates", Value = tolong(DuplicateDeliveries), SortOrder = 1),
(Q | project Metric = "Sequence Gaps", Value = tolong(SequenceGaps), SortOrder = 2),
(Q | project Metric = "Missing Sequences", Value = tolong(MissingSequences), SortOrder = 3),
(Q | project Metric = "Out-of-Order", Value = tolong(OutOfOrderTransitions), SortOrder = 4),
(Q | project Metric = "Null EH Metadata", Value = tolong(NullEhMetadata), SortOrder = 5)
| order by SortOrder asc
| project-away SortOrder

let Q = CurrentStreamTimelinessReport();
union
(Q | project Metric = "P95 Relative Delay", Value = todouble(P95RelativeDelayMs), SortOrder = 1),
(Q | project Metric = "Max Relative Delay", Value = todouble(MaxRelativeDelayMs), SortOrder = 2),
(Q | project Metric = "Max Physical Gap", Value = todouble(MaxPhysicalGapMs), SortOrder = 3),
(Q | project Metric = "P95 Cloud Latency", Value = todouble(P95CloudLatencyMs), SortOrder = 4),
(Q | project Metric = "Max Cloud Latency", Value = todouble(MaxCloudLatencyMs), SortOrder = 5)
| order by SortOrder asc
| project-away SortOrder
CurrentStreamTimelinessReport() | project BurstDrone, MaxBurstEvents, BurstFirstSeq, BurstLastSeq

let LatestRun = toscalar(LatestObservedRun() | project RunId);
TelemetryCanonical
| where simulator_run_id == LatestRun
| summarize arg_max(bronze_ingested_at, *) by drone_id
| extend MapState =
    case(
        asset_state == "AVAILABLE" and mission_status == "COMPLETED", "MISSION COMPLETED",
        asset_state == "ACTIVE" and mission_status == "ACTIVE", "MISSION ACTIVE",
        "OTHER")
| project
    drone_id, 
    battalion_id, mission_id, 
    latitude, longitude, altitude_m, ground_speed_mps, heading_deg,
    battery_pct, asset_state, platform_health, connection_state,
    mission_status, mission_phase,
    MapState,
    bronze_ingested_at

let LatestRun = toscalar(LatestObservedRun() | project RunId);
TelemetryCanonical
| where simulator_run_id == LatestRun
| where drone_id == _droneId
| project
    longitude,
    latitude,
    source_sequence_number,
    mission_phase,
    altitude_m,
    ground_speed_mps,
    battery_pct,
    bronze_ingested_at
| order by source_sequence_number asc

let LatestRun = toscalar(LatestObservedRun() | project RunId);
TelemetryCanonical
| where simulator_run_id == LatestRun and drone_id == _droneId
| order by source_sequence_number asc
| project
    source_sequence_number,
    altitude_m,
    ground_speed_mps,
    battery_pct

let LatestRun = toscalar(LatestObservedRun() | project RunId);
let TargetDrone = _droneId;
StateTransitionsCanonical
| where simulator_run_id == LatestRun and drone_id == TargetDrone
| extend Transition = strcat(previous_state, " → ", new_state)
| project
    Sequence = source_sequence_number,
    Transition,
    Reason = reason_code,
    EventTime = event_time
| order by Sequence asc

let LatestRun = toscalar(LatestObservedRun() | project RunId);
let TargetDrone = _droneId;
let TelemetryEvents = 
    TelemetryCanonical
    | where simulator_run_id == LatestRun and drone_id == TargetDrone
    | project 
        Sequence = source_sequence_number,
        EventTime = event_time,
        EventFamily = "TELEMETRY",
        Detail = strcat(
            "Phase= ", mission_phase,
            " | Alt= ", tostring(round(altitude_m,1)), " m",
            " | Speed= ", tostring(round(ground_speed_mps,1)), " m/s",
            " | Battery= ", tostring(round(battery_pct,1)), "%");
let StateEvents =
    StateTransitionsCanonical
    | where simulator_run_id == LatestRun and drone_id == TargetDrone
    | project 
        Sequence = source_sequence_number,
        EventTime = event_time,
        EventFamily = "STATE_TRANSITION",
        Detail = strcat(previous_state, " → ", new_state, " | ", reason_code);
union TelemetryEvents, StateEvents
| order by Sequence desc;

// Events by type
let LatestRun = toscalar(LatestObservedRun() | project RunId);
RawDroneEvents
| where tostring(simulation.simulator_run_id) == LatestRun
| summarize 
    Events = count()
 by event_type
| order by Events desc

// Total Events
let LatestRun = toscalar(LatestObservedRun() | project RunId);
RawDroneEvents
| where tostring(simulation.simulator_run_id) == LatestRun
| summarize
    Total = count(),
    First_Seen = min(eh_enqueued_time),
    Last_Seen = max(eh_enqueued_time)
| extend
    Duration_s = datetime_diff("second", Last_Seen, First_Seen)
| extend 
    Per_Second = round(Total / iif(Duration_s == 0, 1.0, todouble(Duration_s)), 2)

// Reconciliation
let LatestRun = toscalar(LatestObservedRun() | project RunId);
let RawTelemetry = 
    RawDroneEvents
    | where tostring(simulation.simulator_run_id) == LatestRun and event_type == "telemetry"
    | summarize 
        RawRows = count(),
        RawUniqueEventIds = count_distinct(event_id)
     by event_type
    | extend EventFamily = "TELEMETRY", JoinKey = 1;
let CanonicalTelemetry =
    TelemetryCanonical
    | where simulator_run_id == LatestRun
    | summarize 
        CanonicalRows = count (),
        UniqueCanonicalEventIds = count_distinct(event_id)
    | extend JoinKey = 1;
let RawStateTransitions =
    RawDroneEvents
    | where tostring(simulation.simulator_run_id) == LatestRun and event_type == "state_transition"
    | summarize 
        RawRows = count(),
        RawUniqueEventIds = count_distinct(event_id)
     by event_type
    | extend 
        EventFamily = "STATE_TRANSITION", JoinKey = 1;
let CanonicalStateTransitions =
    StateTransitionsCanonical
    | where simulator_run_id == LatestRun
    | summarize 
        CanonicalRows = count(),
        UniqueCanonicalEventIds = count_distinct(event_id)
    | extend JoinKey = 1;
union 
    (RawTelemetry | join kind=inner CanonicalTelemetry on JoinKey), 
    (RawStateTransitions | join kind=inner CanonicalStateTransitions on JoinKey)
    | extend 
        RawDuplicates = RawRows - RawUniqueEventIds,
        MissingFromCanonical = CanonicalRows - UniqueCanonicalEventIds
    | extend 
        ReconciliationStatus =
        case (
            MissingFromCanonical == 0 and CanonicalRows == UniqueCanonicalEventIds, "OK",
            MissingFromCanonical > 0, "MISSING IN CANONICAL",
            CanonicalRows != UniqueCanonicalEventIds, "DUPLICATES IN CANONICAL",
            "REVIEW"
        )
| project 
    EventFamily, RawRows, RawUniqueEventIds, RawDuplicates, CanonicalRows, UniqueCanonicalEventIds, MissingFromCanonical, ReconciliationStatus
| order by EventFamily asc

let LatestRun = toscalar(LatestObservedRun() | project RunId);
// Raw por drone y familia
let RawByDrone =
    RawDroneEvents 
    | where tostring(simulation.simulator_run_id) == LatestRun and event_type in ("telemetry", "state_transition")
    | summarize EventCount = count_distinct(event_id)
    by
        DroneId = tostring(drone_id),
        EventFamily = toupper(tostring(event_type))
    | extend Source = "RAW";
// Canoical por drone y familia
let CanonicalByDrone = 
    union (
            TelemetryCanonical
            | where simulator_run_id == LatestRun
            | summarize EventCount = count_distinct(event_id)
            by DroneId = drone_id
            | extend EventFamily = "TELEMETRY"
        ),
        (
            StateTransitionsCanonical
            | where simulator_run_id == LatestRun
            | summarize EventCount = count_distinct(event_id)
            by DroneId = drone_id
            | extend EventFamily = "STATE_TRANSITION"
        )
        | extend Source = "CANONICAL";
union RawByDrone, CanonicalByDrone
| summarize 
    RawUniqueEvents = sumif(EventCount, Source == "RAW"),
    CanonicalUniqueEvents = sumif(EventCount, Source == "CANONICAL")
 by DroneId, EventFamily
 | extend Difference = RawUniqueEvents - CanonicalUniqueEvents
 | where Difference  != 0
 | extend 
    Status = 
        case (
            Difference > 0, "MISSING IN CANONICAL",
            Difference < 0, "EXTRA IN CANONICAL",
            "OK")
| order by  abs(Difference) desc, DroneId asc

let S = CurrentFleetOperationalSummary();
union
(S | project Metric = "Total", Value = tostring(TotalDrones), SortOrder = 1),
(S | project Metric = "Connected", Value = tostring(ConnectedDrones), SortOrder = 2),
(S | project Metric = "Disconnected", Value = tostring(TotalDrones - ConnectedDrones), SortOrder = 3),
(S | project Metric = "Connectivity Pct", Value = strcat(tostring((round(ConnectivityPct, 1))), "%"), SortOrder = 4)
| order by SortOrder asc
| project-away SortOrder

CurrentFleetMapView()
| where connection_state != "CONNECTED"
| project
    drone_id,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    battery_pct,
    optic_fiber_remaining_m,
    telemetry_as_of,
    state_as_of,
    telemetry_age_sec

let S = CurrentFleetOperationalSummary();
union
(S | project Metric = "RF Drones", Value = tostring(RfDrones), SortOrder = 1),
(S | project Metric = "Fiber Drones", Value = tostring(FiberDrones), SortOrder = 2),
(S | project Metric = "Mode Coverage", Value = strcat((round(CommunicationModeCoveragePct, 1)), "%"), SortOrder = 3)
| order by SortOrder asc
| project-away SortOrder

CurrentFleetOperationalView()
| summarize Drones = count() by communication_mode
| order by communication_mode asc

CurrentFleetMapView()
| extend optic_fiber_display = iff(communication_mode == "FIBER", strcat(tostring(round(optic_fiber_remaining_m, 1)), " m"),"N/A")
| extend operational_condition =
    case(
        asset_state == "DESTROYED", "DESTROYED",
        mission_status == "ABORTED", "MISSION ABORTED",
        connection_state != "CONNECTED", "DISCONNECTED",
        mission_status == "COMPLETED", "MISSION COMPLETED",
        mission_status == "ACTIVE", "MISSION ACTIVE",
        "OTHER"
    )
| project
    DroneId  = drone_id,
    Mode = communication_mode,
    Optic_Fiber = optic_fiber_display,
    State = connection_state,
    Mission_Phase = mission_phase,
    Mission_Status = mission_status,
    Operational_Condition = operational_condition,
    Platform_Health = platform_health,
    Battery_Pct = strcat((round(battery_pct, 1)), " %"),
    Telemetry_Age_Min = round(telemetry_age_sec / 60.0 ,1)
| order by DroneId asc

CurrentTerminalAssetsView()
| extend
    Terminal_Gap_Sec = round(todouble(datetime_diff("millisecond", state_as_of, telemetry_as_of)) / 1000.0, 1)
| project
    Drone = drone_id,
    Condition = terminal_condition,
    Last_Known_Altitude_m = altitude_m,
    Last_Telemetry = telemetry_as_of,
    Terminal_State_Time = state_as_of,
    Terminal_Gap_Sec

let S = CurrentFleetOperationalSummary();
union
(S | project Metric = "Destroyed Drones", Value = todouble(DestroyedDrones), SortOrder = 1),
(S | project Metric = "Aborted Missions", Value = todouble(AbortedMissions), SortOrder = 2),
(S | project Metric = "Asset Loss %",     Value = todouble(AssetLossPct),    SortOrder = 3)
| order by SortOrder asc
| project-away SortOrder

let S = CurrentCommunicationHealthSummary();
union
(S | project Metric = "Unaffected Links %", Value = HealthyLinksPct, SortOrder = 1),
(S | project Metric = "Affected Links %", Value = AffectedLinksPct, SortOrder = 2),
(S | project Metric = "Disconnected Now", Value = todouble(DisconnectedLinks), SortOrder = 3),
(S | project Metric = "Out-of-Order Events", Value = todouble(OutOfOrderEvents), SortOrder = 4)
| order by SortOrder asc
| project-away SortOrder

CurrentCommunicationHealthView()
| summarize Drones = count() by communication_mode
| order by communication_mode asc

CurrentCommunicationHealthView()
| summarize Drones = count() by communication_condition
| order by Drones desc

CurrentCommunicationHealthView()
| where communication_condition != "HEALTHY"
| extend MaxRelativeDelaySec = round(todouble(MaxRelativeDelayMs) / 1000.0, 1)
| project
    Drone = drone_id,
    Mode = communication_mode,
    Condition = communication_condition,
    OutOfOrder = OutOfOrderEvents,
    MaxDelay_s = MaxRelativeDelaySec
| order by
    MaxDelay_s desc, Drone asc

CurrentLinkStateEventsView()
| project
    Drone = drone_id,
    Mode = communication_mode,
    Event = LinkEventClass,
    Transition = LinkTransition,
    Reason = reason_code,
    EventTime = event_time
CurrentArrivalWindowMetrics() | project Window_Start = WindowStart, Events_per_Sec = EventsPerSecond

CurrentArrivalWindowMetrics()
| project
    WindowStart,
    P95RelativeDelaySec = round(todouble(P95RelativeDelayMs) / 1000.0, 1),
    MaxRelativeDelaySec = round(todouble(MaxRelativeDelayMs) / 1000.0, 1)

RawDroneEvents
    | summarize 
        LastSeenAt = max(eh_enqueued_time)
    by RunId = tostring(simulation.simulator_run_id)
    | top 1 by LastSeenAt desc
    | project-away LastSeenAt

let LatestRun = toscalar(LatestObservedRun() | project RunId);
TelemetryCanonical
| where simulator_run_id == LatestRun
| distinct drone_id
| order by drone_id asc
